此技能教授如何按照 Anthropic 官方规范创建有效的 Claude Code 技能。

### 1. 技能即提示

所有提示最佳实践都适用。要清晰、要直接。假设 Claude 是聪明的——只添加 Claude 没有的上下文。

---
name: my-skill-name
description: 它的作用以及何时使用它
---

# My Skill Name

## 快速开始
立即可操作的指导...

## 说明

my-skill/
├── SKILL.md              # 入口点（必需）

├── examples.md           # 使用示例

```yaml
description: 从 PDF 文件中提取文本和表格、填写表单、合并文档。在使用 PDF 文件或用户提及 PDF、表单或文档提取时使用。
```

```yaml
description: 帮助处理文档
```

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>桐城自摸麻将 - 局域网版</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a472a 0%, #2d5a3d 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* 大厅样式 - 登录界面 */
        #loginScreen {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(13, 40, 24, 0.98);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 200;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        #loginScreen h1 {
            font-size: 48px;
            color: #ffd700;
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px #ffd700;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            animation: glow 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }

        @keyframes glow {
            from { text-shadow: 0 0 10px #ffd700, 0 0 20px #ffd700; }
            to { text-shadow: 0 0 20px #ffd700, 0 0 40px #ffd700, 0 0 60px #ff8c00; }
        }

        #loginScreen .subtitle {
            color: #90ee90;
            font-size: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .name-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 20px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            border-radius: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .name-bar label {
            color: #ffd700;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .name-bar input {
            width: 200px;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            border: 2px solid #ffd700;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .name-bar input:focus {
            outline: none;
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px #ffd700;
        }

        .name-bar input::placeholder {
            color: #666;
        }

        /* 牌桌列表容器 */
        .lobby-container {
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 800px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .lobby-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding: 0 10px;
        }

        .lobby-header h2 {
            color: #ffd700;
            font-size: 24px;
        }

        .btn {
            padding: 10px 20px;
            font-size: 16px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: #4CAF50;
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: #45a049;
        }

        .btn-danger {
            background: #f44336;
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: #607D8B;
            color: white;
        }

        .table-list {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .table-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 15px;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            border: 2px solid transparent;
        }

        .table-card:hover {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .table-card.empty {
            border-color: #4CAF50;
        }

        .table-card.waiting {
            border-color: #FFC107;
        }

        .table-card.playing {
            border-color: #2196F3;
        }

        .table-card.full {
            border-color: #f44336;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        .table-card.new-table {
            background: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.3);
            border: 2px dashed #4CAF50;
        }

        .table-number {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .table-status {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        .table-players {
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 0.8em;
        }

        /* 牌桌列表中的小型圆桌布局 */
        .mini-table-layout {
            position: relative;
            width: 120px;
            height: 120px;
            margin: 10px auto;
        }

        .mini-table-center {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2d5a3d 0%, #1a3d2a 100%);
            border: 2px solid #FFD700;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .mini-seat {
            position: absolute;
            text-align: center;
            width: 32px;
        }

        /* 逆时针顺序: 1(底) → 2(右) → 3(顶) → 4(左) */
        .mini-seat-1 { bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
        .mini-seat-2 { right: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
        .mini-seat-3 { top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
        .mini-seat-4 { left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }

        .mini-seat-avatar {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: 2px solid #555;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .mini-seat-avatar.occupied {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4CAF50, #2E7D32);
            border-color: #81C784;
        }

        .mini-seat-avatar:hover:not(.occupied) {
            background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            border-color: #FFD700;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .table-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 5px;
        }

        .table-id {
            color: #FFD700;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .table-mode-badge {
            font-size: 11px;
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.2);
            color: #FFD700;
        }

        .table-footer {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #ccc;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .table-footer.full {
            color: #ff6b6b;
        }

        .table-footer.playing {
            color: #4dabf7;
        }

        .deck-info {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #90ee90;
            margin-top: 5px;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        /* 创建新桌卡片样式 */
        .create-table-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.3), rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.3));
            border: 2px dashed #4CAF50;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            min-height: 200px;
        }

        .create-table-card .plus {
            font-size: 48px;
            color: #4CAF50;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .create-table-card .text {
            color: #4CAF50;
            font-size: 16px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .create-table-card:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.5), rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.5));
        }

        /* 游戏界面样式 */
        .game-container {
            display: none;
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            position: relative;
        }

        .game-table {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            position: relative;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #2d5a3d 0%, #1a472a 100%);
        }

        /* 玩家区域 */
        .player-area {
            position: absolute;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .player-area.bottom {
            bottom: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 80%;
        }

        .player-area.top {
            top: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }

        .player-area.left {
            left: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .player-area.right {
            right: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .player-info {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            padding: 8px 15px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .player-info.active {
            border: 2px solid #FFD700;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px #FFD700;
        }

        .player-name {
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .hand-count {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        /* 展示区 */
        .showed-area {
            display: flex;
            gap: 5px;
            margin: 5px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .showed-card {
            width: 30px;
            height: 40px;
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #333;
        }

        .showed-card.fa {
            background: #FFD700;
        }

        .showed-card.gang {
            background: #90EE90;
        }

        /* 手牌区域 */
        .hand-area {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1px;
            padding: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a472a 0%, #0d2818 100%);
            border-radius: 10px;
            max-width: 100%;
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }

        /* 麻将牌基础样式 - 图片中的真实样式 */
        .card {
            width: 34px;
            height: 48px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f5f5f0 0%, #e8e8e0 50%, #ddd8d0 100%);
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.1s ease;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 2px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 3px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 4px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 5px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            border: 1px solid #d8d0c8;
        }

        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 3px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 5px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 7px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 9px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .card.selected {
            transform: translateY(-12px);
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 4px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 7px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 10px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 13px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            z-index: 20;
        }

        .card.dragging {
            opacity: 0.6;
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        .card.drag-over {
            border-left: 3px solid #FFD700;
        }

        /* 万能牌样式 - 癞子 */
        .card.wild {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff8e1 0%, #ffecb3 50%, #ffe082 100%);
            border: 2px solid #ffa000;
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #ff8f00,
                0 2px 0 #f57c00,
                0 3px 0 #ef6c00,
                0 4px 0 #e65100,
                0 5px 3px rgba(255,152,0,0.4),
                0 0 10px rgba(255,160,0,0.5);
        }

        /* 癞子标记 */
        .card.wild::before {
            content: '癞';
            position: absolute;
            top: -2px;
            right: -2px;
            width: 13px;
            height: 13px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff5722 0%, #e64a19 100%);
            color: white;
            font-size: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 0 3px 0 4px;
            box-shadow: -1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            z-index: 5;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        /* 牌面内容容器 */
        .card-face {
            width: 28px;
            height: 40px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: #fafaf5;
            border-radius: 2px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
            border: 1px solid #e8e0d8;
        }

        /* 筒子牌 - 圆点图案 */
        .card.tong .card-face {
            position: relative;
        }

        .card.tong .dot-container {
            width: 24px;
            height: 32px;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
        }

        .card.tong .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #90caf9, #1976d2 70%, #0d47a1);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.5),
                0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 1筒 - 大圆带花边 */
        .card.tong.p1 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card.tong.p1 .dot {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #64b5f6, #1976d2 60%, #0d47a1);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.6),
                inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2),
                0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 2筒 */
        .card.tong.p2 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        /* 3筒 */
        .card.tong.p3 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 1 / 3; grid-row: 2; justify-self: center; }

        /* 4筒 */
        .card.tong.p4 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 4px;
            padding: 2px;
        }

        /* 5筒 */
        .card.tong.p5 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; width: 8px; height: 8px; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(5) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 3; }

        /* 6筒 */
        .card.tong.p6 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);

<body>
    <!-- 登录/大厅界面 -->

    <script>
        // 全局变量
        let ws = null;
        let playerId = null;
        let playerName = '';
        let currentTableId = null;
        let selectedCard = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let myIndex = 0;
        let isReady = false;

        // 连接WebSocket
        function connect() {
            const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
            ws = new WebSocket(`${protocol}//${window.location.host}`);

            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已连接');
            };

            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                handleMessage(data);
            };

            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已断开');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (playerId) {
                        connect();
                    }
                }, 3000);
            };

            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket错误:', error);
            };
        }

        // 处理消息
        function handleMessage(data) {
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'loginSuccess':
                    playerId = data.playerId;
                    playerName = data.playerName;
                    // 登录成功后获取牌桌列表
                    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
                    }
                    break;

                case 'tableList':
                    renderTableList(data.tables);
                    break;

                case 'playerList':
                    renderPlayerList(data);
                    break;

                case 'dealStart':
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    showDealAnimation();
                    break;

                case 'gameState':
                    gameState = data.data;
                    myIndex = gameState.myIndex;
                    console.log('收到游戏状态:', gameState);
                    console.log('我的手牌:', gameState.myHand);
                    console.log('手牌数量:', gameState.myHand ? gameState.myHand.length : 0);
                    updateGameUI();
                    break;

                case 'message':
                    addChatMessage(data.text);
                    break;

                case 'error':
                    alert(data.message);
                    break;
            }
        }

        // 确保已登录
        function ensureLogin(callback) {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请先输入名称');
                return false;
            }

            if (!playerId || !playerName) {
                playerName = name;
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    connect();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                        if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                    }, 500);
                } else {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                    if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                }
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // 登录
        function login() {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请输入名字');
                return;
            }

            playerName = name;
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                }, 500);
            } else {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
            }
        }

        // 退出
        function logout() {
            if (currentTableId) {
                leaveTable();
            }
            playerId = null;
            playerName = '';
        }

        // 渲染牌桌列表
        function renderTableList(tables) {
            const container = document.getElementById('tableList');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建新桌卡片
            const createCard = document.createElement('div');
            createCard.className = 'table-card create-table-card';
            createCard.innerHTML = `
                <div class="plus">+</div>
                <div class="text">开房</div>
            `;
            createCard.onclick = createTable;
            container.appendChild(createCard);

            // 现有牌桌
            tables.forEach((table, index) => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                const isFull = table.playerCount >= 4;
                const isPlaying = table.started;

                card.className = `table-card ${isFull ? 'full' : ''} ${isPlaying ? 'playing' : ''}`;

                // 生成圆桌座位显示
                let seatsHtml = '';
                for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    const seatNum = i + 1;
                    const player = table.players.find(p => p.seatNum === seatNum);
                    const occupied = !!player;
                    const occupiedClass = occupied ? 'occupied' : '';
                    const clickHandler = (!occupied && !isPlaying) ? `onclick="event.stopPropagation(); joinTableById('${table.id}', ${seatNum})"` : '';
                    const title = occupied && player ? player.name : (isPlaying ? '' : '点击加入');
                    const displayChar = occupied ? (player ? player.name.charAt(0) : '?') : '+';

                    seatsHtml += `
                        <div class="mini-seat mini-seat-${seatNum}">
                            <div class="mini-seat-avatar ${occupiedClass}" ${clickHandler} title="${title}">
                                ${displayChar}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                // 状态文字
                let statusText = `${table.playerCount}/4 人`;
                let statusClass = '';
                let deckInfo = '';
                if (isPlaying) {
                    const deckCount = table.deckCount !== undefined ? table.deckCount : '?';
                    deckInfo = `<div class="deck-info">剩余: ${deckCount}张</div>`;
                    statusText = '🀄 游戏中';
                    statusClass = 'playing';
                } else if (isFull) {
                    statusText = '已满员';
                    statusClass = 'full';
                }

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="table-header">
                        <div class="table-id">牌桌：${table.tableNumber}</div>
                        <div class="table-mode-badge">${isPlaying ? '游戏中' : '等待中'}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mini-table-layout">
                        <div class="mini-table-center">🀄</div>
                        ${seatsHtml}
                    </div>
                    <div class="table-footer ${statusClass}">${statusText}</div>
                    ${deckInfo}
                `;

                // 点击整个卡片也可以加入（如果未满且未开始）
                if (!isFull && !isPlaying) {
                    card.onclick = () => joinTableById(table.id);
                }

                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        // 通过ID加入牌桌
        function joinTableById(tableId, seatNum = null) {
            joinTable(tableId, seatNum);
        }

        // 创建牌桌
        function createTable() {
            if (!ensureLogin(() => {
                if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'createTable' }));
                }
            })) {
                if (playerId && ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'createTable' }));
                }
            }
        }

        // 加入牌桌
        function joinTable(tableId, seatNum = null) {
            if (!ensureLogin(() => {
                if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'joinTable', tableId, seatNum }));
                    currentTableId = tableId;
                }
            })) {
                if (playerId && ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'joinTable', tableId, seatNum }));
                    currentTableId = tableId;
                }
            }
        }

        // 离开牌桌
        function leaveTable() {
            showLobby();
            currentTableId = null;
            isReady = false;
        }

        // 显示大厅
        function showLobby() {
            document.getElementById('loginScreen').style.display = 'flex';
            document.getElementById('gameContainer').style.display = 'none';
            if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
            }
        }

        // 显示游戏界面
        function showGame() {
            document.getElementById('loginScreen').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('gameContainer').style.display = 'block';
        }

        // 渲染玩家列表
        function renderPlayerList(data) {
            showGame();

            document.getElementById('tableNumDisplay').textContent = data.tableNumber;

            // 更新准备面板
            const seatList = document.getElementById('seatList');
            seatList.innerHTML = '';

            const players = data.players || [];
            for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
                const player = players.find(p => p.seatNum === i);
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'seat-item';

                if (player) {
                    div.classList.add('occupied');
                    if (player.id === playerId) {
                        div.classList.add('me');
                    }
                    div.innerHTML = `
                        <div><strong>${i}号位</strong></div>
                        <div>${player.name} ${player.ready ? '✓已准备' : ''}</div>
                    `;
                } else {
                    div.innerHTML = `
                        <div><strong>${i}号位</strong></div>
                        <div>空位</div>
                    `;
                }
                seatList.appendChild(div);
            }

            // 游戏已开始，隐藏准备面板
            if (data.started) {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.add('hidden');
            } else {
                document.getElementById('readyPanel').classList.remove('hidden');

                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-stick"></div>';

                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';

            } else if (count === 7) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 8) {

            } else if (count === 9) {

            return bamboo;

        function handleDragEnd(e) {
            e.target.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('drag-over');
            });
            draggedCardId = null;
        }

        function handleDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target && target.dataset.cardId !== draggedCardId) {
                target.classList.add('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDragLeave(e) {
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target) {
                target.classList.remove('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDrop(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (!target || !draggedCardId) return;

            const targetCardId = target.dataset.cardId;
            if (targetCardId === draggedCardId) return;

            // 重新排序手牌
            const fromIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === draggedCardId);
            const toIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCardId);

            if (fromIndex !== -1 && toIndex !== -1) {
                const [movedCard] = gameState.myHand.splice(fromIndex, 1);
                gameState.myHand.splice(toIndex, 0, movedCard);
                renderMyHand();
            }

            target.classList.remove('drag-over');

        // 判断是否是万能牌
        function isWildCard(card) {
            if (!gameState || !gameState.wildCard) {
                console.log('isWildCard: 没有gameState或wildCard');
                return false;
            }
            const wild = gameState.wildCard;

            // 调试：打印比较信息

            // 检查是否与翻出的牌相同（精确匹配花色、点数、类型）
            const sameCard = (card.suit === wild.suit &&
                             String(card.rank) === String(wild.rank) &&
                             card.type === wild.type);

            if (sameCard) {
                console.log('匹配：与翻出的牌相同');
                return true;
            }

            // 红中永远是万能牌
            if (card.type === 'arrow' && card.rank === '中') {
                console.log('匹配：红中是万能牌');
                return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        // 获取牌的短名称
        function getCardShortName(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return card.rank;
            } else {
                return card.rank;
            }
        }

        // 获取牌的显示名称
        function getCardDisplayName(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return `${card.rank}${card.suit}`;
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                return card.rank;
            } else {
                return card.rank;
            }
        }

        // 选择牌
        function selectCard(card) {
            if (selectedCard && selectedCard.id === card.id) {
                selectedCard = null;
            } else {
                selectedCard = card;
            }

            // 如果是自己回合且有选中的牌，启用出牌按钮
            const isMyTurn = gameState && gameState.currentPlayer === myIndex;
            document.getElementById('playBtn').disabled = !isMyTurn || !selectedCard;

            renderMyHand();
        }

        // 出牌
        function playCard() {
            if (!selectedCard) return;

            ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                type: 'play',
                cardId: selectedCard.id
            }));

            selectedCard = null;
        }

        // 换发
        // 换發
        function changeFa() {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'changeFa' }));
        }

        // 暗杠
        function doGang() {
            if (selectedCard) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({
                    type: 'gang',
                    cardId: selectedCard.id
                }));
            }
        }

        // 胡牌
        function declareHu() {
            ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'hu' }));
        }

        // 聊天
        function sendChat() {
            const input = document.getElementById('chatInput');
            const text = input.value.trim();
            if (text) {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'chat', text }));
                input.value = '';
            }
        }

        function handleChatKey(event) {
            if (event.key === 'Enter') {
                sendChat();
            }
        }

        // 添加聊天消息
        function addChatMessage(text) {
            const container = document.getElementById('chatMessages');
            const div = document.createElement('div');
            div.textContent = text;
            div.style.marginBottom = '5px';
            container.appendChild(div);
            container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight;
        }

            connect();
        });
    </script>
